concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 4 Baseline Execution → 4.2 `run_raw_baseline.py`: “truncate the full dialogue history to the **median token budget** (computed earlier) before feeding to the same model”
concerns.text: The primary research question asks whether an Intent Graph can replace the *full* raw dialogue history without loss of performance. By truncating the raw‑history baseline to the median token budget derived from the graphs, the baseline is artificially weakened, making the comparison biased in favor of the Graph condition. This creates a methodological flaw: the validation target (raw‑history performance) is not independent of the predictor (graph token budget), leading to a circular/tautological evaluation of latency‑performance trade‑off.
